title: DAF-SELEX Trial 1 - ligand preparation
body:
### MAXlig - ligand with central MAX binding site


![image](assets/img/uploads/2026-10-19-mvf8ktfo-image.png)

*NOTE: Image shows biotinylated primers but we do not use biotinylated primers for this particular experiment - we use phosphorylated primers*

Dilute 1 uL of the oligo to 50 uL total using TE buffer (~60 ng/uL). 

Set up 8X reactions:

Amplification PCR: 35X

For each reaction (25 uL)

| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| FWD (10 uM)  | 2.25 uL |
| REV (10 uM)| 2.25 uL |
| 2X Phusion MM | 12.5 uL |
| MAXlig | ~100 ng |
| Make up to 25 uL|


| °C | time |
| :---- | :---- |
| 95°C | 3 min|
| 98°C | 20 s |
| 60°C | 15 s |
| 72°C | 30 s
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |


- Pool and column purify PCR product
- Check quality of ligand on 2.5% DNA agarose gel
experiments: MAXlig - ligand with central MAX binding site
